_설명: 새 스테이지 기획(D-085) 거점 그림 80장 Gemini 요청 글. 저장: assets/sprites/stage/src/st<N>/<fort|base|barr>_<1|2|3>_gemini.png (1 온전 / 2 파손 / 3 붕괴, 장벽은 1·2만). 1번은 새 대화에 그 스테이지 먼 배경(st<N>/far_gemini.png)을 첨부해 화풍·색만 맞춤, 2·3번은 새 대화에 1번 결과를 첨부해 상태만 바꿈. 배경색은 pending_newplan_bg.json의 key(4단계만 노랑). 거점 설명은 MD/기획_스테이지설계.md '거점', 장벽은 각 스테이지 분위기로 정함. 10-25: 3단계 철문 파손판을 'Edit the attached image … heavily damaged'로 보냈더니 거절('그런 것을 하도록 프로그램되지 않았습니다') → '게임용 건물 스프라이트, battle-worn version'으로 바꾸자 됨. 2·3번 글을 이 말투로 바꿈.
style: Match the pixel-art style of the attached image exactly: 16-bit style pixel art, {mood}, thick dark outlines, limited color palette, subtle rim light from the upper left. The attached image shows the same place: use the same pixel size and colors, but do not copy the scene.
rules:
- Strict side view (profile), orthographic, no perspective tilt
- Background: one perfectly flat solid color only (given above). No shadow, no floor, no gradient, no background props
- Only one subject, fully visible and centered, with generous empty margin on all sides
- No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no border. Keep the bottom-right corner empty
shape_low: Square image, 1:1 aspect ratio. The object is wide and low: about three times wider than it is tall, centered in the image.
destroyed:
This is a pixel-art building sprite for my 2D game. Redraw the attached {thing} as a collapsed ruin, with the same flat pure {key} background and the same pixel art style:
- Nothing is left standing: the {thing} has collapsed
- Only a low, wide pile of wreckage remains, about one third of the original height
{ruin}
- A few small embers and thin dust
- Keep the same left and right edges and the same bottom baseline. No people, no text

fort.desc:
the "security gate" of an underground military bunker, seen strictly from the side as a flat front facade. It faces the LEFT side of the image.
- A massive, firmly closed titanium bulkhead made of thick riveted plates with yellow-black hazard stripes and red warning lights
- On top: an automatic defense turret with a long beam-emitter barrel pointing LEFT
- Colors: gunmetal, dark steel blue, hazard yellow, red lights
fort.dmg:
- Dented and torn titanium plates with several holes, exposed wires and sparks
- The turret barrel bent, its red lights flickering, thin smoke
fort.ruin: - Torn titanium plates, the fallen bent turret and broken hazard-striped beams mixed together on the pile

base.desc:
the "surface-bound giant elevator" of a government military base, seen strictly from the side. It faces the LEFT side of the image.
- A colossal cargo lift: a heavy steel platform stacked with military supply crates and containers, inside a tall steel tower frame with thick cables, pulleys and a winch house on top
- Blinking warning lights, hazard stripes on the platform edge
- Colors: gunmetal, olive drab crates, hazard yellow, red lights
base.dmg:
- The tower frame bent, several cables snapped and hanging, crates broken open
- Sparks from the winch house, thin smoke, lights flickering
base.ruin: - The fallen platform, twisted tower beams, snapped cables and spilled broken crates on the pile

barr.desc:
a low, wide "tank trap barricade" of an underground military base:
- A row of steel czech hedgehog tank traps and stacked sandbags with one short concrete block in the middle, hazard stripes
- Colors: gunmetal, sandbag khaki, hazard yellow
barr.dmg: - Two tank traps knocked over, sandbags torn and spilling sand, the concrete block cracked

fort.desc:
the "coastal breakwater gate" of a corrupt energy corporation, seen strictly from the side as a flat front facade. It faces the LEFT side of the image.
- A huge, thick concrete breakwater wall with a closed steel gate in the middle
- Anti-ship missile turrets crudely bolted all over it, missile pods pointing LEFT
- Rust streaks, hazard-orange and black stripes, a small black-and-orange gear emblem
- Colors: dirty concrete grey, rust brown, hazard orange
fort.dmg:
- Large cracks and broken chunks in the concrete, exposed rebar
- Two missile pods torn off, the rest bent and smoking
fort.ruin: - Broken concrete slabs, exposed rebar, the fallen steel gate and wrecked missile pods on the pile

base.desc:
the "main drilling core" of a corrupt energy corporation, seen strictly from the side. It faces the LEFT side of the image.
- A gigantic drilling tower with a steel lattice derrick, thick pipes plunging down into the ground at its base
- A red-hot pillar of fire blasting out of its top, glowing pipes
- Colors: rust brown, hazard orange, dark steel, magma red
base.dmg:
- The derrick bent and broken in places, pipes burst and leaking fire and smoke
- The fire pillar sputtering
base.ruin: - Twisted derrick beams, burst glowing pipes and scorched machinery on the pile, small flames

barr.desc:
a low, wide "oil drum barricade" of a corrupt energy corporation:
- A row of stacked rusty oil drums and concrete road barriers with hazard-orange stripes, a short chain-link fence segment
- Colors: rust brown, hazard orange, concrete grey
barr.dmg: - Drums knocked over and dented, leaking black oil, the fence torn, a barrier cracked

fort.desc:
the "heretic inquisition iron gate" of a corrupt holy kingdom, seen strictly from the side as a flat front facade. It faces the LEFT side of the image.
- A massive, firmly closed iron gate covered with long sharp iron spikes, set in a dark stone gatehouse frame
- The dried blood of the wrongly executed caked on the spikes and dripping down the gate, chains and torn crimson banners
- Colors: black iron, dark grey stone, dried blood red, faded gold
fort.dmg:
- The gate dented and cracked, several spikes broken off, the stone frame chipped with missing blocks
- Chains snapped, banners torn shorter
fort.ruin: - The fallen spiked gate, broken stone blocks, snapped chains and a torn banner on the pile

base.desc:
the "great cathedral gate", the most splendid yet rotten heart of a corrupt holy kingdom, seen strictly from the side as a flat front facade. It faces the LEFT side of the image.
- A huge arched golden gate between two tall spires, a large stained-glass rose window above it, golden crosses and saint statues
- Signs of rot: black stains and cracks spreading over the gold
- Colors: radiant gold, white marble, stained-glass colors, rotten black
base.dmg:
- The golden gate dented and cracked, the rose window shattered, one spire broken at the top
- Black rot spreading, thin dust
base.ruin: - Broken golden gate doors, shards of stained glass, toppled saint statues and fallen crosses on the pile

barr.desc:
a low, wide "holy cross shield wall" of a corrupt holy kingdom:
- A row of five large tower shields planted upright side by side, white and gold, each painted with a red cross
- Iron spikes and wooden stakes between the shields, a rope tied across
- Colors: white, gold, blood red, grey iron
barr.dmg: - Two shields cracked and tilted, one fallen forward, the crosses chipped, the rope cut, a few stakes broken

fort.desc:
a "pulsing flesh wall" from a cosmic abyss, seen strictly from the side. It faces the LEFT side of the image.
- A huge barricade of raw red-purple flesh that beats like a giant heart, thick veins all over it
- Vein openings on its front (LEFT side) dripping venomous green liquid, bone spikes on the top
- Colors: raw flesh red, dark purple, bioluminescent green venom, bone white
fort.dmg:
- Torn flesh with gaping wounds, several veins burst and leaking venom, bone spikes broken
- The wall sagging
fort.ruin: - A heap of torn, withered flesh, burst veins, broken bone spikes and puddles of venom

base.desc:
the "cosmic cocoon" at the heart of a cosmic abyss, seen strictly from the side. Its front faces the LEFT side of the image.
- A gigantic ominous chrysalis standing upright, its shell of overlapping dark violet chitin with glowing green cracks
- Thousands of thin tentacles reaching up from its top into the sky
- Colors: dark violet, chitin black, bioluminescent green, flesh red
base.dmg:
- Large cracks and broken chitin plates, some tentacles torn off and limp, green glow leaking
- Thin smoke
base.ruin: - Broken chitin shell pieces, limp severed tentacles and glowing green ooze on the pile

barr.desc:
a low, wide "carapace barricade" from a cosmic abyss:
- A row of large overlapping dark purple chitin plates growing out of raw flesh like a wall, with curved bone spikes between them
- Thin glowing green veins on the plates
- Colors: dark purple, bone white, bioluminescent green, flesh red
barr.dmg: - Two plates cracked in half and tilted, one fallen forward, several bone spikes broken, veins torn

fort.desc:
the "sea blockade floodgate" of a naval fortress, seen strictly from the side as a flat front facade. It faces the LEFT side of the image.
- A massive, firmly closed steel floodgate with heavy rivets, brass fittings and gear wheels
- On top: a huge electric harpoon launcher pointing LEFT, crackling with blue sparks
- Colors: dark navy steel, corroded brass, rust, electric blue
fort.dmg:
- Dented and buckled gate plates leaking water, rivets popped, the harpoon launcher bent
- Sparks and steam
fort.ruin: - Buckled gate plates, broken gear wheels, the wrecked harpoon launcher and puddles of seawater on the pile

base.desc:
the "central control drilling core" of a naval fortress, seen strictly from the side. It faces the LEFT side of the image.
- A gigantic cylinder-shaped main core of riveted steel with brass portholes, pumping polluted sludge up from the deep sea
- Thick pipes plunging down at its base, toxic green glow in the portholes, a control bridge on top
- Colors: dark navy steel, corroded brass, rust, toxic green
base.dmg:
- Cracked hull with holes leaking toxic sludge, pipes burst, portholes shattered
- Smoke and steam
base.ruin: - Broken hull plates, burst pipes, shattered portholes and puddles of toxic sludge on the pile

barr.desc:
a low, wide "anchor chain barricade" of a naval fortress:
- A row of steel hatch plates and sandbags with heavy anchor chains strung between short bollards, two rusted spiked naval mines on stands
- Colors: dark navy steel, rust, brass, sandbag khaki
barr.dmg: - Hatch plates knocked over, chains snapped, sandbags torn, one mine stand toppled

fort.desc:
the "incinerator of burning" of a corrupt holy hospital, seen strictly from the side as a flat front facade. It faces the LEFT side of the image.
- A huge round gear-shaped iron door of a corpse incinerator in a white marble and gold frame, the furnace glowing orange behind its grilles
- Flamethrower nozzles on its front pointing LEFT, soot stains and dried blood
- Colors: sterile white marble, hypocritical gold, black iron, furnace orange, dried blood
fort.dmg:
- The gear door cracked with broken teeth, the marble frame chipped, nozzles bent and spitting weak fire
- Black smoke
fort.ruin: - The fallen cracked gear door, broken marble blocks, bent nozzles and smoldering ashes on the pile

base.desc:
the "Sanctuary of the Grail", an underground altar of a corrupt holy hospital, seen strictly from the side. It faces the LEFT side of the image.
- A grand golden altar frame with angel ornaments, two tall glass tanks full of blood on its sides connected by transfusion tubes
- An EMPTY space in the middle of the frame above the altar (where a floating boss will be)
- Surgical lamps hanging from the top
- Colors: hypocritical gold, sterile white, blood red, glass
base.dmg:
- The glass tanks cracked and leaking blood, angel ornaments broken, tubes torn
- One surgical lamp hanging loose
base.ruin: - Shattered glass tanks, broken golden ornaments, torn tubes and pools of blood on the pile

barr.desc:
a low, wide "hospital bed barricade" of a corrupt holy hospital:
- Iron hospital beds and stretchers chained together side by side with folding surgical screens, bloodstained white sheets
- Colors: sterile white, black iron, dried blood red, gold trim
barr.dmg: - Beds overturned and bent, screens torn, chains snapped, sheets ripped

fort.desc:
the "steel trench bunker" of an imperial artillery army, seen strictly from the side. It faces the LEFT side of the image.
- A heavy, low concrete bunker bristling with anti-tank gun barrels and machine guns sticking out of its firing slits, all pointing LEFT
- Sandbags piled around it, steel plates, a small black cannon emblem
- Colors: ash grey concrete, gunmetal, mud brown, sickly yellow light from the slits
fort.dmg:
- Big cracks and chunks blown off the concrete, exposed rebar, two barrels bent
- Sandbags torn, black smoke
fort.ruin: - Broken concrete blocks, bent gun barrels, rebar and torn sandbags on the pile

base.desc:
the "imperial forward command tower", seen strictly from the side. It faces the LEFT side of the image.
- A tall concrete and steel lattice tower rising high, with many radio antennas and big loudspeakers on its top platform, a searchlight
- A small black cannon emblem, barbed wire around its base
- Colors: ash grey, gunmetal, sickly yellow lights
base.dmg:
- The lattice bent, several antennas and loudspeakers broken off and hanging, the searchlight shattered
- Smoke
base.ruin: - Twisted lattice beams, broken antennas, smashed loudspeakers and concrete chunks on the pile

barr.desc:
a low, wide "barbed wire barricade" of a trench battlefield:
- Wooden cheval-de-frise frames wrapped in barbed wire with a short wall of sandbags
- Colors: dark wood, rusty wire, sandbag khaki, ash grey
barr.dmg: - Frames broken and tilted, wire cut and sagging, sandbags torn

fort.desc:
the "boiling furnace castle gate" of a frozen kingdom, seen strictly from the side as a flat front facade. It faces the LEFT side of the image.
- A huge, firmly closed steel gate glowing red-hot, set in an icy stone gatehouse covered with snow and icicles
- Furnace vents at the bottom of the gate breathing fire, a flame-crown emblem
- Colors: red-hot steel, furnace red, frost blue stone, white snow
fort.dmg:
- The gate cracked and partly cooled dark, vents broken, the stone frame chipped, icicles fallen
- Steam and smoke
fort.ruin: - The fallen cracked gate, broken icy stone blocks, glowing embers and melted snow on the pile

base.desc:
the "main furnace-stone altar" of a frozen kingdom, seen strictly from the side. It faces the LEFT side of the image.
- A huge red-hot furnace stone pulsing on a stepped stone altar, a royal golden throne on top of the altar
- Steel braziers and chains around it, ice and snow everywhere else
- Colors: furnace red glow, gold, dark stone, frost blue, white snow
base.dmg:
- The furnace stone cracked with its glow flickering, the throne broken, altar steps chipped
- Steam and smoke
base.ruin: - Shattered furnace stone shards dimly glowing, the broken throne and altar blocks on the pile

barr.desc:
a low, wide "furnace shield barricade" of a frozen kingdom:
- A row of ice-covered steel shields planted in the snow, each with a small glowing furnace stone in its center, wooden stakes between them
- Colors: steel, frost blue, white snow, furnace red
barr.dmg: - Shields knocked over and bent, furnace stones cracked and dark, stakes broken

fort.desc:
the "illegal tollgate" of a corrupt construction company, seen strictly from the side. It faces the LEFT side of the image.
- A heavy concrete barrier wall with a toll booth and a closed striped boom gate
- Heavy machine guns mounted on top pointing LEFT, a small gold coin emblem
- Colors: concrete grey, hazard yellow and black stripes, rust
fort.dmg:
- Cracked concrete with holes, the boom gate snapped, the booth windows shattered, guns bent
- Smoke
fort.ruin: - Broken concrete slabs, the snapped boom gate, a crushed booth and bent guns on the pile

base.desc:
the "main crane tower" of a corrupt construction company, seen strictly from the side. It faces the LEFT side of the image.
- A sky-piercing giant tower crane with a tall steel lattice mast and a long jib, a glowing load core box at the base of the mast (its weak point)
- Hazard-yellow paint, neon magenta warning lights
- Colors: hazard yellow, steel grey, neon magenta, concrete
base.dmg:
- The mast bent, the jib cracked and drooping, the load core sparking
- Smoke
base.ruin: - The collapsed twisted mast and jib, the shattered load core and concrete chunks on the pile

barr.desc:
a low, wide "construction roadblock":
- A row of yellow-black plastic road barriers and concrete jersey barriers with traffic cones and rebar bundles
- Colors: hazard yellow, black, concrete grey, orange cones
barr.dmg: - Barriers knocked over and cracked, cones crushed, rebar bent

fort.desc:
the "signal blocking bulkhead", the main security door of a cyberpunk broadcasting station, seen strictly from the side as a flat front facade. It faces the LEFT side of the image.
- A massive, firmly closed black glossy security door with neon magenta light strips
- Countless small laser sensors on it shooting thin red-pink laser beams to the LEFT
- Colors: obsidian black, neon magenta, chrome, concrete grey
fort.dmg:
- Cracked panels with holes, sparking wires, light strips flickering, sensors broken
- Smoke
fort.ruin: - Broken black panels, sparking wires, smashed sensors and chrome debris on the pile

base.desc:
the "top-floor core room" of a cyberpunk broadcasting tower, seen strictly from the side. It faces the LEFT side of the image.
- A huge ring-shaped frame of server racks and broadcast consoles with glowing screens (abstract glow only, no readable text) and thick cables
- An EMPTY space in the middle of the ring (where a floating boss will be)
- Colors: obsidian black, neon magenta, chrome, concrete grey
base.dmg:
- Server racks cracked and sparking, screens shattered and glitching, cables torn
- Smoke
base.ruin: - Smashed server racks, shattered screens, torn cables and chrome debris on the pile

barr.desc:
a low, wide "riot control barricade":
- A row of black riot barriers with neon magenta light strips and glowing holographic warning tape (no text)
- Colors: obsidian black, neon magenta, chrome
barr.dmg: - Barriers knocked over and cracked, light strips dark, the hologram tape glitching
